scenes.title: SCADA-AI Convergence: New Risks
scenes.narration: Integrating SCADA systems (🏭) with AI (🧠) promises efficiency but significantly expands the attack surface, introducing novel cybersecurity risks to critical infrastructure operations.

scenes.title: Expanded Attack Surface
scenes.narration: Traditional air-gapped SCADA (🏠) gains connectivity for AI (☁️), creating new entry points (🚪) for adversaries, from data ingestion to model deployment.

scenes.title: AI Model Poisoning
scenes.narration: Adversaries can inject malicious data (🧪) into the AI training set, leading to a compromised model (🧠) that issues incorrect or harmful commands to SCADA (🏭).

scenes.title: AI Evasion Attacks
scenes.narration: Adversaries can craft adversarial examples (🎭) that fool the AI (🧠), causing it to misinterpret legitimate SCADA data and potentially trigger malicious actions (💥).

scenes.title: Attribution Challenges
scenes.narration: Pinpointing the source of an attack becomes harder with AI. Was it a human operator error (👤), a software bug (🐛), or a sophisticated AI-driven cyberattack (🕵️)?

scenes.title: Tradeoff: Efficiency vs. Security
scenes.narration: AI boosts operational efficiency (📈) and predictive maintenance (⚙️) in SCADA, but this comes at the cost of increased cybersecurity complexity (🔒) and potential vulnerabilities.

scenes.title: Limitations: AI Vulnerabilities
scenes.narration: AI models are inherently susceptible to data bias (⚖️), lack of explainability (❓), and robustness issues (🛡️), which can be exploited to compromise SCADA operations.

scenes.title: Defense: Multi-Layered Security
scenes.narration: Unlike traditional perimeter defense (🧱), SCADA-AI integration demands a multi-layered approach (🧅) including network segmentation, zero-trust, and AI-specific threat detection.

scenes.title: Application: Smart Grids
scenes.narration: In smart grids (⚡), AI optimizes energy flow, but a compromised AI could cause widespread power outages ( blackout emoji) or manipulate energy markets, impacting millions.

scenes.title: Application: Water Treatment
scenes.narration: AI optimizes water treatment (💧) and distribution. A cyberattack could poison the AI, leading to incorrect chemical dosing and posing severe public health risks (😷).

scenes.title: Edge Case: Supply Chain Attacks
scenes.narration: A supply chain attack (🔗) targeting AI models or data used in SCADA can inject vulnerabilities before deployment (📦), making detection extremely difficult post-integration (🔍).

scenes.title: Future: AI for Defense
scenes.narration: AI can also be a powerful defense tool (🛡️), enabling advanced anomaly detection (🚨) and rapid threat response (⏱️) in complex SCADA environments, turning the tables on attackers.

scenes.title: Synthesis: Secure SCADA-AI
scenes.narration: Securing SCADA-AI requires a holistic strategy (✅) combining robust cybersecurity practices (🔒) with AI-specific defenses (🧠) to protect critical infrastructure from evolving threats.
